name: Mind & Emotions
description: What’s shaping your mental landscape — including your thoughts, focus, inner voice, and how memories, mental load, or personal interpretation affect you.

contexts.name: Internal Emotional Influences
contexts.description: Internally triggered shifts in emotional state based on your interpretations, expectations, or reflections.

positive: Noticed a moment of calm within myself
Accomplished something I had been putting off
Found meaning in something I did today
Reminded myself of personal growth
Felt alignment between values and actions
neutral: Moved through the day on autopilot
Completed routine tasks without much reflection
Followed habits or rituals without emotion
Experienced a thought without attaching meaning
negative: Felt disconnected from my inner world
Criticized myself for not doing enough
Struggled to find purpose in the day
Felt emotionally numb or disengaged internally

contexts.name: Focus & Clarity
contexts.description: The state of your mental sharpness, presence, and capacity to concentrate.

positive: Completed a mentally engaging task
Got into a focused rhythm
Worked through something complex successfully
Felt mentally refreshed after a break
Organized thoughts with clarity
neutral: Moved through familiar tasks without effort
Let my thoughts drift calmly
Was present but not highly focused
Processed input without strong attention
negative: Experienced internal mental noise or chaos

contexts.name: Self-Talk & Inner Voice
contexts.description: The quality and tone of your internal dialogue — how you're speaking to yourself right now.

positive: Supported myself with kind thoughts
Mentally encouraged myself to keep going
Affirmed my decisions
Practiced gentle accountability
Used internal validation over external approval
neutral: Planned my next steps mentally
Reflected on something without judgment
Thought through tasks methodically
Had mental silence or stillness
negative: Mentally replayed what I did wrong
Compared myself internally to a standard I couldn’t meet

contexts.name: Mental Load & Energy
contexts.description: How much cognitive effort you're handling and how mentally taxed or energized you feel.

positive: Felt intellectually challenged in a good way
Balanced tasks without mental strain
Paced myself well across mental demands
Had space to think creatively
Used energy on something I care about
neutral: Engaged in light mental activity
Did habitual thinking patterns
Was mentally passive for a while
Alternated between attention and rest
negative: Tried to do too much at once mentally

contexts.name: Memory & Mental Imagery
contexts.description: Thoughts, flashbacks, or imagined scenarios currently affecting your mental state.

positive: Revisited a personal success or turning point
Imagined a future I feel drawn toward
Remembered something that motivates me
Visualized something creative or expressive
Connected with a personal insight from the past
neutral: Replayed a neutral memory or image
Mentally wandered through abstract thoughts
Visualized a familiar routine or daydream
Recalled facts or timelines without emotion
negative: Got stuck in a loop of regretful thoughts
Had a flashback to something painful
Mentally rehearsed a failure or fear
Was triggered by a personal memory I didn’t expect
